goal.objective:
The Discord and Channel Talk providers are implemented in Rust in the hyper-messenger workspace, each with a real HTTP client, credentials, and the core Provider read/send operations, wired through the sdk to the CLI, MCP server and HTTP server, and proven by real-surface QA.

Deliverables (literal): crates/providers/discord and crates/providers/channeltalk (HTTP client, Provider impl, AuthProvider impl, credentials under <config>/<provider>), each with a base-URL env override; provider unit tests; wiring in crates/sdk/src/lib.rs register_builtin.

Success criteria (binary, each with a named real-surface scenario):
- C1 Discord read: CLI `chats discord`/`messages discord` against a local mock Discord API (base URL env override) exits 0 and returns the seeded guilds/channels/messages.
- C2 Discord send: CLI `send discord <channel> <text>` against the mock posts and returns the created message id/content.
- C3 Discord error: mock returns 401; CLI exits non-zero with envelope error code AUTH_FAILED.
- C4 Channel Talk read: CLI `whoami channeltalk`/`chats channeltalk`/`messages channeltalk` against a local mock desk API returns seeded data.
- C5 Channel Talk send: CLI `send channeltalk <chat> <text>` against the mock round-trips.
- C6 Channel Talk error: mock returns 401; envelope error code AUTH_FAILED, non-zero exit.
- C7 Cross-surface: HTTP server `GET /v1/providers/discord/chats` and `/v1/providers/channeltalk/chats` return 200 with seeded data; MCP `list_chats {provider: discord}` returns seeded data.
- C8 Quality gate: `cargo test --workspace --all-features` green, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean, `cargo fmt --all --check` clean.

Constraints and scope bounds: credentials load from config/env and can be set via `auth login`; desktop-app and browser token extraction (macOS Chromium cookie decryption), the Discord gateway websocket listener, and media/emoji/sticker/reaction/thread operations are OUT of scope. assumed: HTTP base URLs overridable by env var so behavior is provable without live credentials — reversible, and required for real-surface QA. Reference implementation: /tmp/agent-messenger-ref/src/platforms/{discord,channeltalk}.

WHEN TO STOP: I'll stop right away when both providers are implemented, wired, and proven by real-surface QA (CLI and HTTP/MCP against a mock HTTP server plus unit tests green), landed on the dev branch.
